summary: New modules and plugins contributed to Ansible should always have integration tests, marked with the unsupported alias if they can't run in Ansible CI.
questions: Do I need integration tests if my module can't run in Ansible's CI?
How do I mark integration tests that can't run in CI?

answer_card.title: Integration tests for new modules
answer_card.answer_md: Yes, every new module and plugin contributed to Ansible needs integration tests. If they can't run on Ansible CI, mark them with the `unsupported` alias in the target's `aliases` file.
